name: Pinochle
description: Pinochle is a classic card game that combines two distinct phases: **melding** (showing combinations of cards for points) and **trick-taking** (winning individual tricks to score additional points). Played with a unique 48-card deck containing two copies of each card from 9 to Ace, Pinochle offers deep strategic gameplay centered around the auction/bidding phase where players compete to name the trump suit.

content.text: Pinochle is a classic card game that combines two distinct phases: **melding** (showing combinations of cards for points) and **trick-taking** (winning individual tricks to score additional points). Played with a unique 48-card deck containing two copies of each card from 9 to Ace, Pinochle offers deep strategic gameplay centered around the auction/bidding phase where players compete to name the trump suit.

Pinochle traces its roots to the German card game Binokel (also spelled Binocle), which emerged in the mid-19th century. The name "Pinochle" is believed to derive from the French word "binocle" meaning "eyeglasses" or "pince-nez," possibly referring to the paired nature of the double deck.
4 players in fixed partnerships (partners sit opposite).
48-card Pinochle deck (two copies each of 9, 10, J, Q, K, A in all four suits).

1. Shuffle the 48-card deck thoroughly
2. Deal 12 cards to each player (in batches of 3 or 4 cards)
3. Rotation: Deal rotates clockwise after each hand

items.text: Double-Deck Pinochle: Uses 80-card deck; 20 cards each; different meld and trick scoring.
